    The connecting maps η : E(C, A) → K(Q)(F C, (F A)⟦1⟧) (Proposition 2.3, Step 3) #

    The realization functor on C_J is F = (CDJ ≌ C_J)⁻¹ ⋙ realF. Since Γ ∘ F ≅ single ∘ ρ and Γ is bijective on K(Q)(F C, (F A)⟦1⟧), every class δ ∈ E(C, A) = Ext¹(ρC, ρA) = D(ρC, ρA⟦1⟧) has a unique preimage η δ. Additivity, naturality and bijectivity of η follow from the corresponding properties of Ext¹.
